description: Defines the Reviewer entity class for the OrangeHRM performance review plugin, including properties, ORM mappings, and accessor methods.

classes.name: Reviewer
classes.description: Entity class representing a reviewer in the performance review system, with properties for status, comments, related group, review, employee, and ratings.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the reviewer.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the reviewer.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the reviewer.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the reviewer.

methods.name: getCompletedDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the review was completed.

methods.name: setCompletedDate
methods.description: Sets the completion date of the review.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns the comment associated with the review.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets the comment for the review.
